lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and economy. Add Sentries for defensive capabilities and detection.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to a single ground unit type and neglecting support units or upgrades, leaving you vulnerable to Warp Prism harass.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to respond to harass.
lessons.title: Ground vs Ground with Warp Prism Harass
lessons.when: Midgame, opponent shows ground posture with Zealots, Sentries, and Warp Prisms. You have Zealots and a heavy economy.
lessons.why: The opponent's use of Warp Prisms suggests potential harass. Sentries can provide shields and force fields to defend. Maintaining a strong economy will support a larger army.

lessons.correction: Transition to include anti-air units such as Stalkers or Phoenixes. Continue developing your economy and tech.
lessons.mistake: Staying pure ground without anti-air, or over-committing to air without proper tech.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions back to ground or if you need to commit to air.
lessons.title: Early-Midgame Air Threat with Void Rays
lessons.when: Early-midgame, opponent shows air posture with Void Rays. You have a ground army with Zealots and a strong economy.
lessons.why: Void Rays are strong against ground units. Adding anti-air will help defend against an air attack and maintain map control.

lessons.correction: Prioritize adding anti-air units and possibly transition to an air army yourself. Continue developing economy and tech.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting anti-air upgrades or staying too passive if the opponent is massing air.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent switches to ground or if you need to commit to a full air transition.
lessons.title: Midgame Air Mass with Void Rays
lessons.when: Midgame, opponent has an air posture with Void Rays. You have a ground army with Zealots and a strong economy.
lessons.why: The opponent's air army is a significant threat. Investing in anti-air or transitioning to air will help you counter their composition.
